description.text:
The deck that won the Senior Division of the 2011 World Championships: a simple, fast deck in which Typhlosion's Afterburner keeps bringing Fire Energy back from the discard pile so that Reshiram can use Blue Flare turn after turn. Reshiram and Typhlosion decks also came second in the Junior Division and took two of the top four places in Masters. The 2011 World Championships were held at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, California, from 12 to 14 August 2011, with more than 400 card and video game players from over 27 countries.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2011 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
